utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me which repair drive you mean and what’s been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the one for the apartment repairs — I think they’ve checked the lights and maybe the leak, but I might be mixing that up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Cleo — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — that’d help a lot. I’ll keep track of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things quiet on my side right now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. We can keep it low-key and work around your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Rosa, I’m a little late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — we’re doing well so far, and I’m glad you made it. I can fill you in on what’s left to sort.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Mina — I’m in. Tell me what time and what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you come by around 10 and bring a drill if you have one?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What part of the repair drive do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks — could you just take the supplies list and check what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to spread the word or sort out what we still need?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—could you spread the word and help keep track of what we still need? I’ll start inviting folks too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping track of the repair drive locations—do you want the drop-off spot or the next place on the list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the drop-off spot would help me most. I don’t want to lose track of it again.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs doing, and when should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with that—let’s make a quick list of what needs fixing, then we can meet tomorrow evening to split up the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly hands for lifting and sorting donations, plus anyone handy with basic repairs would be great.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I just heard they’re keeping it this weekend. I can swing by and tell you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s do the drop-off at the community hall first, then we can sort the repair drive timing after that.
